cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's applause. Our real mission is entertaining base. I'm singing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they've switched off. You've lost our audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. I'm handing you the microphone; refuse me a second verse.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Perfect. Grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. Put them beside the wine; this door is catering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your dragon can stay for tea. Please keep the biscuit crumbs off my carpet.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. He's fine here. Wait, three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbors see.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.text: His three heads breathe fire. Should I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He's fine here. Wait, three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbors see.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Get the stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up. I've still got my muddy boots on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! Socks too if they're damp. We are not adding footprints to that water ring.
